name: Test card
description: A hardback standing in three-quarter view whose cover is a broadcast test pattern: seven colour bars over a strip of castellations and a black-level band with its white square, its cream page edges turned toward you.
choices: The colour bars that fill the screen after closedown fill a book cover instead, so the symbol is a book first and television second
Bars are pulled toward ochre, teal, plum and brick to keep clear of neon cyan and magenta; no station box or lettering
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
